baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled construction تَتَّبِعُوا/يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ makes following discrete traces the repeated action, while ش ط ن supplies distance and rupture.
baseline_models.mechanism: A walker does not arrive at فحشاء and منكر in one leap. Tracing one footprint after another creates path dependence: each bounded step makes the next available, progressively crossing limits and carrying the walker into estrangement and moral unrecognizability.

activation_trace.role: Following as tracing one mark after another supplies the incremental path mechanism.
The span between two feet makes each movement a bounded, repeatable unit.
Distance and severance provide the path's cumulative direction away from secure relation.
Exceeding a limit identifies the threshold-crossing outcome of accumulated steps.
Change into something unknown or disapproved marks the end state as a deformation of recognition.

changed_reading.before: The verse forbids isolated acts of obedience to Satan because they lead to major sins.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses incremental path formation: small trace-following decisions progressively cross limits, create distance, and make the resulting conduct morally unrecognizable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَتَّبِعْ, يَأْمُرُ, and their consequences join following, command, and outcome in one conditional chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated compliance lets an alien command acquire practical authority. The long-cord image in ش ط ن and the attached liability in ت ب ع make the sequence resemble a tether: following both binds the follower to the commanding source and leaves a consequence attached to the follower.

activation_trace.role: An attached claim or consequence turns following into liability rather than neutral imitation.
The long, tightly twisted cord supplies a material image for cumulative attachment to a remote source.
Demand and obligation make the source more than a suggester: it behaves as a rival commander.
The opposite of recognition characterizes what this rival authority normalizes.

changed_reading.before: Satan offers temptations that an individual may accept or reject.
changed_reading.after: Each compliance helps install a rival command relation: the follower becomes tethered to its demands and acquires the liability that follows them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exhaustive مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا is reversed by وَلَكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى, shifting purification's effective agent.
baseline_models.mechanism: فضل and رحمة are not merely rewards after self-purification. Gifted surplus and tender care are the prior medium in which purification can occur; ز ك و holds removal of corruption together with positive growth, while the negative construction excludes every person and every duration from self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Gift and benefaction supply the enabling provision that the counterfactual says cannot be omitted.
Tender mercy supplies a sustaining relation rather than a merely forensic cancellation.
Growth and increase make purification a positive development, not only removal.
Purity and soundness retain the cleansing dimension within that growth.
Exhaustive negation blocks every individual exception to dependence on grace.
Duration and permanence extend that blocked self-sufficiency across time.

changed_reading.before: Divine grace forgives a person after the person resists or falls into sin.
changed_reading.after: Divine gift and mercy are the prior productive condition for any cleansing growth at all; purification cannot be extracted from the isolated self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier speech sequence converts plural footsteps into a relay. A truth-diverted claim is held by a mutually supporting group, received at the tongue, and diffused among believers; each reception and retransmission is a small followable trace, and each participant acquires a share of the resulting liability.

activation_trace.role: Trace-by-trace following provides the focus mechanism that the speech relay concretizes.
A path made of visible traces lets each transmitted item become the next person's cue.
A lie diverted from truth supplies the distorted object passed along the path.
A surrounding, mutually supporting group turns an individual path into a transmission network.
Acquisition assigns each relay participant a personally gained share of the wrongdoing.
Receiving speech by taking it up and prompting it names the handoff between relay nodes.
Diffusion and spreading describe the network-scale result of repeated handoffs.
Manifest ugliness is the same focus outcome now shown spreading through a community.

structural_cues: 24:11 places a surrounding group beside the statement that each person acquired a share.
24:12-16 repeat hearing, saying, tongues, mouths, and lack of knowledge before 24:19 names social spread.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a group, individual acquisition, tongue-level reception, and diffusion; I supply the arrow that treats each speech handoff as one of the focus's plural steps. The live alternative is that خُطُوَات remains broader than rumor even though rumor is a concrete instance.

changed_reading.before: The steps form an individual's private progression toward obscenity.
changed_reading.after: The steps can be socially distributed: receiving and repeating an unverified claim leaves a trace for the next speaker, spreads obscenity, and allocates liability across the relay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The فضل and رحمة that make purification possible are immediately given a social outlet. People possessing surplus and capacity continue giving, erase the offense's trace, turn from retaliation beautifully, and seek divine covering; grace therefore interrupts the harmful sequence by being relayed rather than hoarded.

activation_trace.role: Divine benefaction is the focus's enabling source.
Tender mercy keeps the enabling source relational.
Growth identifies what the received grace is meant to produce.
Benefaction now characterizes human holders who can pass provision onward.
Material breadth supplies practical capacity for continued giving.
Erasure of a trace models refusal to preserve the offense as the next retaliatory step.
Beautifully turning aside from the offense gives the counter-path a social action.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer makes divine forgiveness the desired pattern and destination.
The returning mercy closes the relay at the same source named in the focus.

structural_cues: 24:20 repeats فضل and رحمة immediately before the focus, and 24:22 moves from possessors of فضل and سعة to giving, pardon, and turning the page.
24:22 motivates human pardon by asking whether its hearers desire God's forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated grace language and a sequence from possessed surplus to pardon and desired forgiveness; I infer that received grace is meant to circulate as a counter-sequence. The alternative is that 24:22 is an adjacent injunction rather than an enacted form of the focus's purification.

changed_reading.before: Purification depends on a divine gift received by an otherwise incapable individual.
changed_reading.after: The gift remains divine in origin but becomes socially active: its recipient interrupts retaliation through continued giving, trace-erasure, and pardon, allowing grace to generate further purification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later uses of أزكى place purification at the first controllable boundary: before entry, permission is required and refusal triggers return; before desire develops, sight is reduced and vulnerable openings are guarded. These are practical brakes on the earliest step rather than repairs after arrival.

activation_trace.role: Crossing or overstepping supplies the boundary dimension latent in each step.
Purity is the focus outcome that the later boundary practices concretize.
Entering an interior supplies a literal threshold where movement can be stopped.
Permission makes crossing dependent on another person's authorized boundary.
Returning supplies a reversible counter-movement when entry is refused.
The text explicitly marks that return at the threshold as purer.
Reducing and restraining input places a brake at the visual intake stage.
Eyesight identifies the sensory gate being regulated.
Guarding sanctity and chastity gives sustained protection to the vulnerable boundary.
An open place of vulnerability supplies the guarded opening in the mechanism.
The repeated purity judgment links sensory restraint to the same focus outcome.

structural_cues: 24:27-28 conditions movement into another household on recognition, greeting, and permission, then calls returning أزكى.
24:30 moves from lowered sight to guarded openings and again calls the practice أزكى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit أزكى judgments attached to entry and sensory boundaries; I infer that they are concrete anti-step controls for 24:21. The alternative is that the repeated root marks independent etiquettes without specifying the mechanism of Satanic following.

changed_reading.before: Avoiding Satan's steps means resisting a temptation once its moral content is apparent.
changed_reading.after: Purity is protected upstream by governing thresholds, permissions, attention, and openings, with immediate return functioning as a positive counter-step.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah recurrence materializes ز ك و as a circulation of increase: people give zakāt, God increases them from فضل, and giving zakāt with responsive obedience opens toward mercy. The purification of 24:21 can therefore include an outward release of value that prevents growth from becoming self-enclosed.

activation_trace.role: Growth and increase provide the focus sense that later giving makes materially visible.
Surplus and remainder supply the excess from which the growth cycle operates.
The shared root places named giving inside the branch image of growth and increase.
Explicit increase supplies the return movement in the circulation.
Increase coming from surplus reconnects the cycle to the focus's فضل.
The command to give zakāt makes growth an enacted communal practice.
Responsive obedience supplies the willing movement that carries the practice.
Mercy is the relational horizon toward which giving and obedience move.

structural_cues: 24:37 names giving zakāt, 24:38 immediately answers faithful work with increase from فضل, and 24:56 joins zakāt and obedience to hoped-for mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ز ك و, explicit increase from فضل, and mercy after giving; I infer a circulation model linking inner purification to outward release. The live alternative is that zakāt and يُزَكِّي activate distinct senses of the root and should not be functionally fused.

changed_reading.before: God's purification is chiefly an inward cleansing of an individual.
changed_reading.after: One material expression of divinely sourced growth may be outward circulation: value is released through zakāt, answered by increase from فضل, and held within mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later obedience sequence supplies a rival path architecture. Satan commands what is منكر, contrary to recognition; faithful response is hearing joined to obedience and طاعة معروفة, recognized good. Legitimate command leads toward guidance and explicit burdens, whereas resistance appears as covert slipping away, concealment behind others, and taking a different path.

activation_trace.role: Demand and obligation establish the focus's rival command source.
Contrariety to recognition marks the quality produced by that command.
Divine hearing places all spoken commands and responses within an audited field.
Hearing as understanding and compliance turns reception into a deliberate response.
Willing submission supplies the alternative following relation.
The repeated command root makes the source-of-command contrast explicit.
Obedience names the movement expected on the legitimate path.
Recognized good directly reverses the focus's unrecognized or disapproved outcome.
Entrusted burden makes responsibility explicit rather than leaving a hidden attached liability.
Gentle direction to a path gives obedience a stated destination.
Slipping out supplies a covert counter-movement away from the collective command.
Hiding behind another person describes how the evasive path masks itself.
Taking a path different from another's gives مخالفة a spatial path image.

structural_cues: 24:47 contrasts a claim of faith and obedience with subsequent turning away; 24:51 gives the response سمعنا وأطعنا.
24:53 places command beside طاعة معروفة, while 24:63 places covert departure and concealment beside مخالفة عن أمره.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the منكر/معروفة reversal, hearing-obedience, guidance, assigned burdens, and covert departure from command; I infer that 24:21 concerns authentication between rival command paths, not only appetite. The alternative is that the later passages regulate public authority without defining Satanic influence.

changed_reading.before: The command in 24:21 is a generic metaphor for temptation.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts rival regimes of response: one normalizes what defeats recognition and attaches hidden liability, while the other is heard, recognized as good, responsibility-bearing, and path-guiding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 24:31 juxtaposes a follower category with feet making hidden adornment knowable; it does not equate those referents with Satan or redefine that ayah's rules. It remains anchored to the focus's following and footsteps as a mechanism of trace production, and downstream prose should present it only as an information-channel analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: In 24:21 a person follows preexisting footsteps; 24:31 activates the inverse possibility that bodily movement itself emits a cue another person can register.

activation_trace.role: Following behind another supplies the receiver side of a trace channel.
Footsteps as traces supply the signal that can remain available to a follower.
The follower category keeps the relation of one person moving after another active in the context.
The bundled leg and foot occurrence grounds the explicit bodily source of the revealing cue.
Removal of concealment supplies the informational effect produced by the movement.
Something becoming known completes the movement-to-information channel.

changed_reading.before: Satan supplies a silent path and the human only walks it.
changed_reading.after: A walker may also emit socially legible traces; one person's small movement can disclose what was hidden and become another person's next followable cue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain move from linear walking to optical layering, so it should not be stated as a lexical definition of خُطُوَات. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus supplies repeated increments and growing distance, while 24:35 and 24:40 supply illumination versus covering; downstream prose should retain explicit analogical qualification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural steps and the distancing branch of ش ط ن permit a cumulative model in which each movement reduces access to orientation.

activation_trace.role: Bounded repeated steps supply discrete units that can accumulate.
Increasing distance and severance supply the loss of orientation produced by accumulation.
Illumination supplies the counter-medium in which a path becomes visible.
A cover rising over something supplies one layer of cumulative occlusion.
The second mapped covering branch preserves the same occurrence's alternate inventory and reinforces concealment.
The stated absence of illumination supplies the terminal condition of lost visibility.

changed_reading.before: Each step advances horizontally toward a bad destination.
changed_reading.after: Each step may also add a covering layer that makes the path harder to see, while divinely given illumination functions as restored navigability.

strongest_changes: The rumor sequence makes footsteps distributed speech events: each reception and repetition leaves the next trace and assigns a share of liability.
The grace refrain becomes a social counter-sequence in 24:22, where possessed فضل is relayed through giving, trace-erasure, and pardon.
Repeated أزكى judgments move purification upstream into permission, return, visual restraint, and guarded openings.
منكر is reversed by طاعة معروفة, sharpening the verse into a contrast between rival command paths and their modes of response.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence turned 24:21 from a general warning into a process map: traces can be spoken, spatial, sensory, distributive, or institutional, while فضل and رحمة generate counter-movements rather than only repairing a completed fall.
remaining_uncertainties: The social relay from divine فضل to human pardon is strongly sequenced but remains a reader-supplied causal arrow.
The zakāt occurrences may activate a materially distinct sense from God's act of يُزَكِّي, so the circulation model should remain secondary.
The foot-signal and layered-occlusion readings are anchored analogies, not lexical equations.
